# Nyasha Nziramasanga

> Senior Mobile Engineer based in Melbourne, Australia, specialising in React Native, iOS, Android, mobile architecture and agentic developer tooling.

- Site: https://www.nyashanziramasanga.com/
- Role: Senior Mobile Engineer — React Native, iOS, Android & Agentic Tooling
- Location: Melbourne, Australia
- Current company: Linktree
- Focus: Scalable mobile products, creator experiences, mobile architecture and developer experience

## About

Nyasha builds and scales polished mobile products used by millions of people. At Linktree, he helps ship React Native experiences for creators worldwide, with an emphasis on reliable delivery, thoughtful architecture and simple product experiences.

## Flagship work

- **Creator monetisation and payments:** Mobile commerce work spanning Wallet, Digital Products, Shop and Bookings, with public coverage from TechCrunch.
- **Agentic mobile developer tooling:** NDA-safe internal workflows that combine relevant repository context, bounded tasks, verification and human review.
- **Launching and scaling Linktree's React Native app:** Work across the original launch, onboarding, profile editing, commerce and creator workflows, plus a public React Native engineering talk.

## Engineering focus

- Mobile engineering: React Native, TypeScript, iOS, Android, GraphQL, state management, testing, CI/CD and mobile architecture.
- Agentic workflow: Agentic tooling, Claude Code, OpenAI and Cursor.
- Product and platform: React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, GCP, AWS, Bun, Git and Figma.

## Experience

- **Linktree** (Jan 2022 – present): Senior Software Engineer; previously Software Engineer II, Mobile App and Software Engineer, Mobile App.
- **Contract Software Engineer — Good Dog Design** (Mar 2021 – Dec 2021).
- **Intern Web Developer — Carbar Auto** (Oct 2018 – Jan 2019).

## Education

- **Master of Science (Computer Science)** — Flinders University (2020 – 2021).
- **Bachelor of Information Technology and Systems** — Monash University (2014 – 2018).
